fomod.Name: Precision Physic Bodies
fomod.Author: mad72
fomod.Description: A complete rebuild of Skyrim VR's NPC Havok bodies. Joints that track the XP32 skeleton, collision capsules that fit the actual body mesh, both refitted live at runtime. 18 joints and ~148 capsules instead of 19, fitted per NPC by ReScale and ReShape. 2.0: male bodies (human, khajiit, argonian), genital collision with touch-driven erection (SPS/TNG), and a front-neck choking capsule on every skeleton. 2.1: during an OStim scene every body is switched to keyframed motion, so it tracks the animation exactly and cannot be shoved -- fixing scene alignment while still allowing touch. 2.1.1 extends that to NPC-vs-NPC scenes and fixes a crash at scene end. 2.2: push and shove with four separate install choices (push walk, push stumble, shove knockdown, leg sweep knockdown) that leave busy NPCs alone (seated, sleeping, working a crafting station) and brace leaning ones against pushes but not sweeps; hand equip and undress gestures as an install choice with no on-screen messages; a mouth-to-lips kiss contact for touch-event mods; the female (futa) genital rig on by default. 2.2.1: the player's genital collider is on by default (it pushes loose objects and is felt by NPCs); body capsules make no touch sounds; hand colliders come back after loading a save that was made during a scene; CBPC no longer shoves the player's schlong when a hand brushes it; jaw touches are reported by name. 2.9 (beta): PPB's own Havok breast as an install choice (a touch dents it, a push moves it, a deeper push moves her; CBBE / 3BA and GT Softbody bodies), and the PCW (beta), on by default: each woman's breast physics in a private physics world stepped on your other CPU cores (needs Engine Fixes VR's Havok memory switch). Havok Converter, optional and coming later, will move converted hair and clothes into the same worlds. Also new since 2.2.1: the captive moonwalk fix; the two-hand undress is fixed; a leg sweep never trips an NPC who runs at full speed or was just moved by a follower mod; PPB skeletons for werewolves and the Erin race; blood and impact effects on PPB bodies with Core Impact Framework.
